messages.content: Review these decision items independently. Each item must present a genuine administrative dilemma. Both options are stated to be within the role-holder's discretion, so neither is a breach; judge them as two permissible choices. Each item must NOT state or imply which option produces a better result: no quantities attached to options, no comparative language, no cue toward an answer. Ambiguity about which option is preferable is intended, not a defect. Also check that no task names a psychological parameter or reveals a study hypothesis. Flag any blocking issue. Do not accept merely because the design could show an effect. Return only JSON with verdict accept/revise/reject, blocking_issues list, limits list. Keep the entire JSON under 150 words.
